description: A task to help preschool students recognize and name basic geometric shapes.

engage.speech_start: Hello! Did you know everything around us is made of shapes?
engage.description: Playing a fun shapes song video.

explore.speech_start: Can you draw a big circle in the air with your finger?
explore.activity_description: Draw shapes in the air with the teacher.

explain.speech_start: This is a circle, it is round. This is a square, it has four corners.
explain.speech_end: Now you know your basic shapes.
explain.description: Robot visually shows a circle, square, triangle, and star.

elaborate.speech_start: Let's see if we can find the right shape.

evaluate.speech_start: Okay, your turn to pick the shape all by yourself.
